messages:
Morgan: FYI found a dead link in the runtime batching guide pointing to a deleted gist: `https://gist.github.com/redwood/batch-drafts`
Sam: thanks — can take it. do you want the replacement to be an internal example page or inline snippet?
Morgan: internal example page is better for reuse. patch both EN and JA if present.
Taylor: saw same link in `docs/ja/runtime/batching.md` and `docs/reference/batching.md`. @Sam if you update files, please update the ja copy too or leave a TODO for i18n team.
Sam: plan: replace gist URL with `/docs/examples/batching-primer.md`, add a one-line changelog in the PR, run a quick grep for the old URL and sed replace. patch command I'll use: `git grep -l \"batch-drafts\" | xargs sed -i \"s|https://gist.github.com/redwood/batch-drafts|/docs/examples/batching-primer.md|g\"`
Ben: nice. ping me once PR is up, I can spin a staging preview and smoke the anchors + examples.
docs-bot: link-scan: 2 occurrences found in tree: `docs/reference/batching.md` and `docs/ja/runtime/batching.md`.
Sam: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2022. includes a short README in `/docs/examples/batching-primer.md`. I left a note in the PR description about backporting to `release/1.2`.
Taylor: quick reading + left a tiny wording suggestion. no blockers.
Ben: staging preview green, sample code renders, and tables look okay.
deploy-bot: staging build passed — build 2024-03-12T09:14:02Z.
Sam: merging in ~30m unless anyone objects. will open backport PR after merge.
Morgan: go for it. thanks!
Sam: main merged and backport opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2023 (target `release/1.2`).
deploy-bot: backport CI success on `release/1.2` — build 2024-03-12T11:02:18Z.
Sam: backport merged. closing thread. :tada:
Morgan: great — appreciate the fast turnaround, saved a likely support ticket.
